note: The account's own templates; the first is chosen for calendar meetings below.

templates.name: Client call
templates.instructions: Focus on what the client asked for, commitments made, deadlines, concerns raised, and next steps. Group action items by who owns them.

templates.name: General
templates.instructions: Write a summary, key points, decisions, action items with owners, and open questions.

templates.name: Interview
templates.instructions: Summarise the candidate's background, strengths, concerns, notable answers, and any follow-up questions. Do not give a hire or no-hire verdict.

templates.name: Team update
templates.instructions: Group by person or workstream: progress, blockers, and what is planned next. List decisions and action items at the end.
